- 修复已识别 Java、但无法找到同一 JDK 中 keytool 的问题，改善证书导入与签名环境检测。
- 兼容 Java 启动器、符号链接和 Java 8 的 JDK/jre 目录布局，保留 JAVA_HOME 与 PATH 兜底。
- 无需迁移配置或重新加固已有 APK；Java 最低要求仍为完整 JDK 8。

- Fixed keytool discovery when Java is detected but tools in the same JDK are missed.
- Improved support for Java launchers, symbolic links and Java 8 JDK/jre layouts, retaining JAVA_HOME and PATH fallbacks.
- No configuration migration or re-hardening is required. A full JDK 8 or newer is still required.
